text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While doing some shopping at the mall
on my day
off, I spot Oguri Cap and
Tamamo Cross having a
look around.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, sure are. But it's no ordinary
shoppin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're takin' a trip down memory lane!
C'mon,
Oguri, spill the beans!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growwwl.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...'Ey! All that tells us is how hungry ya
are!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Guess I gotta explain it myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a Kansai food fair
goin' on, so
us two're gonna check it out
together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What she said. So, you'll have to excuse
us. Our
okonomiyaki awaits.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, not so fast! What am I, your
spokesperson?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, stop! Don't charge on ahead!
You're
gonna get lost again, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them leave in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A short while later...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... This fair is farther than I
thought. It feels
like we've been walking
for miles.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. We meet again. What a
coincidence,
given how big this mall is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama? No, she's... Wait. Tama?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Could this mean... Tama's gotten lost?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She might be feeling lonely. Quick, we
have to
find her!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we'll definitely find her that way.
Let's
hurry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, have you seen an
Umamusume with a
Kansai accent?

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk A
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I can't say that rings any bells.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? She's about as fast as I am.

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I can't really tell how fast someone
is just
standing here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Well, let me know if you see
anyone
like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I can't find her anywhere. I
wonder where
she could have gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Argh... All this rushing around is making
me
hungry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wuzzat what I think it was?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! This's why I told ya not ta go
on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, there you are! I'm so glad you're
safe.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Although... It turns out you're the one
who found
me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We got your ear-splittin' stomach
rumblin' to
thank for that. So long's
you're hungry, I could
track ya down in
an instant.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? I guess an empty stomach
isn't
always a bad thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't go lookin' all smug now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All right. We're back together and I'm
hungry.
Time for that okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to join us, Trainer? I'm sure
it'd be
fun for the three of us to eat
together.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Always on your own terms, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I won't argue, though. I'm starvin' after
all that
walkin' around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, the three of us eat
okonomiyaki
together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good point. Maybe she's gone on
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But that's where we were heading in the
first
place. And I still haven't made it
there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things could get problematic if I leave
Oguri Cap
on her own. I decide to take
her to the food fair.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's a relief. Look, Tama's over
there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh there ya are! Wait, why's your trainer
here
too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that Oguri Cap had been
walking around
in circles, so I decided to
bring her here myself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's my fault for takin' my eyes off ya. I dunno how anyone can get lost so quick, but still.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame yourself. Everyone gets lost
every
now and then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, as long as you're safe, that's
what
matters. I'm here for you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're da one who went missin', not
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her sharp retort echoes throughout the
whole
Kansai food fair.
